# What each instrument is worth

Craton-mini trained again with one instrument left out, scored on the same frozen tasks. A **share** is how much worse the model gets without that instrument, in the task's own unit (positive = the instrument helps). It counts only beyond noise: two standard deviations over 3 seeds, the ratchet's rule. Where a variant can't answer a task (no GNSS: no station to rebuild; no quakes: nothing to forecast), the cell is blank.

| Task | All three | without Earthquakes | without GNSS | without Tides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CB-01 geo-perplexity | 15.09 ± 0.06 bits | **+0.81** | **+6.59** | +0.25 (noise ±0.74) |
| · a hidden quake | 20.65 ± 0.38 bits | **+1.83** | -0.14 (noise ±0.76) | +0.50 (noise ±1.54) |
| · a hidden GNSS day | 9.52 ± 0.27 bits | -0.20 (noise ±0.54) | **+13.31** | -0.01 (noise ±0.54) |
| CB-02 Apennines 2016-17 | -11.11 ± 0.45 bits/quake | · | +0.52 (noise ±0.90) | -0.07 (noise ±1.43) |
| CB-03 L'Aquila 2009 | -18.14 ± 4.01 bits/quake | · | · | · |
| CB-04 GPS gap-fill | 17.50 ± 0.02 mm | +0.25 (noise ±0.47) | · | -0.02 (noise ±0.04) |
